findings.one_line: The finite-error bound gives sufficient conditions for coverage, but the statement says coverage tends to 1-alpha only if the block-event and score failure probabilities vanish; these upper-bound devices need not vanish when coverage holds, so replace 'only if' by a sufficient-condition claim.

cited_checks.note: The attested Proposition A.4 gives the displayed donor-column plus observed-row expansion and its three-term uniform remainder at probability 1-O(min{N_o^-9,T_o^-9}); the stated block substitution is exact.
The attested Lemma 3.1 has exactly the max-covariance Delta_0 bound, requires only coordinate variance bounds for Y, and imposes no covariance minimum-eigenvalue condition.

The attested Theorem 2.1 and Corollary 2.1 give the stated unit-variance supremum and absolute-supremum concentration bounds; the finite-vector sqrt(log(2p)) consequence follows from the standard Gaussian expected-maximum bound.
The attested Theorem 2.1 states Conditions E and M and the fourth-root log^5 hyperrectangle bound, with constants depending only on b1,b2 and no positive covariance minimum-eigenvalue condition.
The attested published setup and Theorem 3.2 match the approximate-rank, i.i.d.-homoskedastic selected-functional scope and its six selected-block condition families.
